title: Variable Fractional Delay
text: Delay input by time-varying fractional number of sample periods, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Interpolation mode} sets Method of interpolation; {Interpolation filter half-length (P)} sets the half length of interpolation filter, {Interpolation points per input sample} sets the number of interpolation points per input, {Normalized input bandwidth (0 to 1)}, {Farrow filter length (N)} sets the length of Farrow filter, {Maximum delay (Dmax) in samples}, {Input processing} sets the method to process the input Columns, {InitialConditions} sets the initial values in the memory, {Disable direct feedthrough by increasing minimum possible delay by one}, {For small input delay values} sets the action to take for small input delay values Clip to the minimum value necessary, {Valid delay range (in samples)} sets the range of valid delay values Read-only, {Rounding mode} sets the rounding method for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Coefficients} sets the data type of the coefficients Same word length, {Product output} sets the data type of the product output Same as first, {Accumulator} sets the data type of accumulation operation Same as product, {Product output polyval} sets the data type of the product polynomial value Same as first, {Accumulator polyval} sets the data type of the accumulator polynomial value Same as first, {Multiplicand polyval} sets the data type of multiplicand polynomial value Same as first, {Output} sets the data type of block output Same and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Delay
ports.summary: Delay input scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Interpolation mode
params.values: Method of interpolation Linear (default) | FIR | Farrow

params.name: Interpolation filter half-length (P)
params.values: Half length of interpolation filter 4 (default) | positive integer in the range [1 65535]

params.name: Interpolation points per input sample
params.values: Number of interpolation points per input sample 10 (default) | positive integer in the range [2, 65,535]

params.name: Normalized input bandwidth (0 to 1)
params.values: Normalized input bandwidth 1 (default) | real scalar in the range (0, 1]

params.name: Farrow filter length (N)
params.values: Length of Farrow filter 4 (default) | integer greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Maximum delay (Dmax) in samples
params.values: Maximum delay 100 (default) | integer in the range [0 65535]

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process the input Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: InitialConditions
params.values: Initial values in the memory 0 (default) | scalar | 1-by- R -by- D array | 1-by- R -by-( D+L ) array

params.name: Disable direct feedthrough by increasing minimum possible delay by one
params.values: Disable direct feedthrough off (default) | on

params.name: For small input delay values
params.values: Action to take for small input delay values Clip to the minimum value necessary for centered kernel (default) | Use off-centered kernel | Switch to linear interpolation if kernel cannot be centered

params.name: Valid delay range (in samples)
params.values: Range of valid delay values Read-only: [0 100] (default) | [ D min D max ]

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding method for fixed-point operations Zero (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Floor | Nearest | Round | Simplest

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Data type of the coefficients Same word length as input (default) | Specify word length

params.name: Product output
params.values: Data type of the product output Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Data type of accumulation operation Same as product output (default) | Same as first input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Product output polyval
params.values: Data type of the product polynomial value Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Accumulator polyval
params.values: Data type of the accumulator polynomial value Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Multiplicand polyval
params.values: Data type of multiplicand polynomial value Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of block output Same as accumulator (default) | Same as first input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
